k_tests.test_question: Does there exist a physically and experimentally accessible operating envelope where inter-wire frictional slip and stress-induced Martensitic phase transformation coexist simultaneously?
k_tests.w2_09_astra_challenge: MAJOR_CHALLENGE: Coexistence was bounded analytically (~0.75% outer fiber strain) but not demonstrated in an accessible, durable operating envelope. Small-strain collapse to linear elastic wire jamming (H0a domain) and membrane integrity remain live blocking threats.
k_tests.evidence_basis: Stage 3 W06 mechanics derivation; Reedlunn et al. 2013 (Part I & II); Carboni et al. 2015; Astra critique G03.
k_tests.residual_uncertainty: Whether achievable curvature in a sealed pressurized bundle activates transformation without causing membrane puncture, severe core arching, or low-cycle fatigue of outer wires.
k_tests.required_future_evidence: Experimental identification of simultaneous slip and transformation regime across defined (p, kappa, T) space.

k_tests.test_question: Can an independently calibrated, established transformation-aware NiTi constitutive model coupled to Coulomb friction (H0b) adequately predict the pressure-controlled bending response?
k_tests.w2_09_astra_challenge: CONFIRMED_GAP: CRITICAL; H0b (existing NiTi constitutive law + Coulomb contact) has not been run with locked calibration on pressure-curvature paths. H0a rejection cannot discriminate H1.
k_tests.evidence_basis: Vahidi et al. 2022 (Abaqus UMAT); Kang et al. 2020; Auricchio 1997; Astra critique G01.
k_tests.residual_uncertainty: High likelihood that standard nonlinear finite-element models or beam contact formulations already match moment-curvature data within reasonable error tolerances, killing H1.
k_tests.required_future_evidence: Numerical simulation of H0b with locked parameters on pressure-curvature paths evaluated against held-out experimental test cases.

k_tests.test_question: Can macroscopic moment-curvature softening curves uniquely isolate stress-induced transformation from inter-wire slip, cross-section ovalization, and membrane compliance?
k_tests.w2_09_astra_challenge: CONFIRMED_GAP: CRITICAL; Global M-kappa data are non-identifying; local DIC/FBG/IR/slip channels are proposed but not executed and can still be confounded by clamps, packing, axial tension, and temperature.
k_tests.evidence_basis: Astra critique G04; Stage 3 W08 report; W2-03 identifiability audit; Salvatore et al. 2021.
k_tests.residual_uncertainty: Observational equivalence between multiple softening mechanisms under macroscopic load-displacement measurements.
k_tests.required_future_evidence: Implementation of local diagnostic channels (embedded FBG sensors, external DIC, infrared thermal imaging, LVDT end-slip) within the pressurized bundle.

k_tests.test_question: Does the candidate contribution collapse to trivial parameter variation of existing jamming systems without generating a new predictive mechanics question?
k_tests.w2_09_astra_challenge: MAJOR_CHALLENGE: Device/jamming/active-pressure novelty is closed or downgraded. Only model discrimination remains; contribution value is strictly conditional on a measurable H0b failure.
k_tests.evidence_basis: MP1-V001 adjudication; Bai et al. 2022; Liu et al. 2021; Takashima et al. 2022-2026; Wang et al. 2024.
k_tests.residual_uncertainty: If H0b suffices, zero novel contribution remains since device architecture is 100% prior art.
k_tests.required_future_evidence: Strict framing of the research as model-validity / model-discrimination under declared error tolerances.

k_tests.test_name: Closer Prior Art & Citation Protocol Closure
k_tests.test_question: Does the repository evidence corpus or adjacent structural literature contain direct prior art describing pressure-controlled superelastic NiTi bundle bending mechanics?
k_tests.w2_08_verdict: NO_KILL_FOUND (noting historical open status of B11/B12 in subrun W2-08)
k_tests.w2_09_astra_challenge: MAJOR_CHALLENGE: The 15/15 stop condition is now true, but it means all required directions were screened under the protocol; citation closure is protocol closure, not universal novelty.
k_tests.evidence_basis: outputs/verification/MP1-V002/citation_coverage.json; FINAL_ADJUDICATION.json; B11 and B12 screening logs.
k_tests.residual_uncertainty: Universal absence of closer prior art outside the V002 search cutoff date (2026-09-25) cannot be guaranteed.
k_tests.required_future_evidence: Preserve explicit protocol-bounded scope in all publications; targeted search reopen only upon concrete high-threat discovery.

k_tests.test_question: Can external chamber pressure p be accurately and uniquely mapped to inter-wire normal contact forces f_n across the bundle cross-section?
k_tests.w2_09_astra_challenge: CONFIRMED_GAP: HIGH; Chamber pressure is a boundary input, not a known inter-wire normal force f_n. Membrane hoop stress, packing/arching, curvature and axial load make p -> f_n underdetermined without independent calibration.
k_tests.evidence_basis: Astra critique G09; Stage 3 W05 report; Tjahjanto et al. 2017.
k_tests.residual_uncertainty: Severe attenuation and spatial non-uniformity of contact forces due to membrane hoop stress, sheath compliance, and geometric void arching under bending.
k_tests.required_future_evidence: Independent calibration protocol for pressure transmission ratio alpha_trans(p, kappa) via pressure-film transducers, wire pull-out testing, or validated cross-section contact FEA.

k_tests.test_question: Are existing beam stick-slip contact formulations (e.g. Tjahjanto 2017, Barsi 2025, Xin Liu 2004) already capable of capturing pressure-dependent NiTi bundle bending when supplied with tangent modulus E_t(sigma, eps_dot)?
k_tests.w2_09_astra_challenge: MAJOR_CHALLENGE: Existing cable/contact incremental formulations can accept nonlinear constitutive laws. No forward calculation shows a phenomenon they cannot reproduce.
k_tests.evidence_basis: Barsi et al. 2025; Tjahjanto et al. 2017; Xin Liu 2004; Salvatore et al. 2021; Astra critique G07.
k_tests.residual_uncertainty: Classical incremental beam contact formulations may completely capture the behavior without requiring any novel field equations or micro-coupling terms.
k_tests.required_future_evidence: Analytical derivation or numerical proof demonstrating that classical stick-slip beam mechanics cannot represent coupled phase-transformation contact behavior.

k_tests.test_name: Parameter Origin & Leakage under Locked Calibration
k_tests.test_question: Can model parameters be independently identified and frozen prior to bending validation, preventing parameter compensation?
k_tests.w2_09_astra_challenge: CONFIRMED_GAP: HIGH; Locked Calibration Rule is a protocol requirement, not demonstrated data. mu, pressure transmission, prestrain, contact penalty and effective stiffness can compensate.
k_tests.evidence_basis: Astra critique G08; Fang et al. 2019; Stage 3 W09/W10 reports.
k_tests.residual_uncertainty: Cross-talk and mutual compensation between friction coefficient mu, pressure transfer ratio alpha_trans, contact penalty, and transformation plateau stress.
k_tests.required_future_evidence: Execution of an independent parameter calibration protocol on separate single-wire, direct-shear, and membrane-inflation tests prior to bundle bending evaluation.

k_tests.test_question: Can the observed hysteresis loops and stiffness variations be uniquely attributed to NiTi transformation and friction, isolated from thermal self-heating, loading rate, and mechanical wear?
k_tests.w2_09_astra_challenge: UNRESOLVED: MEDIUM/HIGH residual risk; Hysteresis and stiffness are confounded by latent heat, rate, friction, training, wear, geometry, and clamp compliance. Quasi-static loading alone does not identify phase versus friction.
k_tests.evidence_basis: Silva et al. 2022; Liu et al. 2026; Astra critique G12; Stage 3 W08.
k_tests.residual_uncertainty: Latent heat (10-25 J/g) shifts NiTi transformation stress (dsigma/dT ~ 6-8 MPa/C), altering stiffness and hysteresis dynamically during cyclic loading.
k_tests.required_future_evidence: Strict quasi-static rate control (eps_dot < 10^-4 s^-1) verified by surface thermocouple/IR thermography, combined with standardized definitions of D_tan, D_sec, and D_dyn.
